source_checks.name: compiler_format_negative_tests
source_checks.semantics: Compile the intentionally invalid printf call with GNU -Werror=format; require rejection for the format diagnostic, not an unrelated compiler failure.

source_checks.name: compiler_return_address_gnu_tests
source_checks.semantics: Compile and execute the GNU -O0 caller-identity probe; this mixed build/runtime qualifier remains mandatory until a peer-owned pure runtime registration exists.

source_checks.name: physx_dependency_contract_tests
source_checks.semantics: Verify pinned PhysX dependencies, stale-source rejection and standalone consumer build contracts; preserve the existing positive and negative probes.

source_checks.name: vt_link_inventory_tests
source_checks.semantics: Inspect Ninja generated link commands: exact compositor object set, required narrow libraries and forbidden broad engine dependencies. Does not launch Vulkan; historical CTest DEPENDS is ordering only.

source_checks.name: viewer_graph_tests
source_checks.semantics: Configure synthetic viewer graphs and enforce their positive and negative target/dependency contracts.

source_checks.name: python_contract_tests
source_checks.semantics: Configure shader commands with direct Python and a spaced launcher path; preserve executable selection, version and launcher-argument assertions.

source_checks.name: shader_rebuild_tests
source_checks.semantics: Build and mutate a synthetic shader/include fixture to verify incremental depfiles and regeneration.

source_checks.name: shader_input_list_tests
source_checks.semantics: Preserve embedding and shader-input-list validation, including malformed/missing inputs and source/build contract assertions.

source_checks.name: windows_build_wrapper_contract
source_checks.semantics: Preserve build-wrapper preflight, configure/build argument forwarding and negative contract fixtures.

source_checks.name: editor_registration_census
source_checks.semantics: Run the real editor registration census, compare the reviewed manifest, append an unregistered PE string decoy and require no false live registration. Mixed runtime/disk qualifier pending peer conversion.

source_checks.name: shader_source_tests
source_checks.semantics: Inspect the shader source closure and retain all existing positive and mutation-negative shader/CPU composition contracts; source-text input belongs in lint.

behavioral_policy_checks.name: matter_engine_headless_consumer_tests
behavioral_policy_checks.semantics: Construct LocalProvider and validate its linked public host-baker interface; keep the executable in PR/full runtime CTest.

behavioral_policy_checks.name: matter_mesh_allocator_policy_tests
behavioral_policy_checks.semantics: Execute graphical MemAlloc/MemFree and headless allocator-hook dispatch assertions; keep both probes in PR/full runtime CTest.

custom_checks.name: windows_ci_contract_tests
custom_checks.semantics: Preserve tier/package selection, build ownership, cache fingerprint, incomplete baseline and failure propagation guards.

custom_checks.name: shader_external_build_tests
custom_checks.semantics: Preserve the complete cross-drive shader/include rebuild fixture on staging/main/nightly or explicit packaging.
